_about: Topic diagrams shown when a recognized sign or corrected fingerspelled word matches a keyword. Mermaid flowchart source; keep each one small and check the science.

topics.title: Force
topics.mermaid:
flowchart TD F["Force = a push or a pull"] --> P["Push: moves away"] F --> Q["Pull: comes closer"] P --> L["F = m × a
force = mass × acceleration"] Q --> L L --> N["Measured in newtons (N)
1 N = 1 kg·m/s²"]

topics.title: Gravity
topics.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  E["Earth"] -->|pulls toward its center| O["Any object, e.g. an apple"]
  O --> W["Weight = mass × g"]
  W --> G["g ≈ 9.8 m/s² on Earth"]
  G --> X["Example: 10 kg × 9.8 m/s² = 98 N"]

topics.title: Energy
topics.mermaid:
flowchart TD A["Ball at the top of a ramp
stored (potential) energy"] -->|rolls down| B["Ball moving fast
moving (kinetic) energy"] B -->|friction| C["Heat in the ramp and air"] C --> D["Energy is not lost,
it changes form"]

topics.title: Animal cell
topics.mermaid:
flowchart TD M["Cell membrane
controls what goes in and out"] --> C["Cytoplasm
jelly that fills the cell"] C --> N["Nucleus
the control center"] N --> D["DNA
instructions for the cell"] C --> MI["Mitochondria
release energy from food"]
